end.summary:
Practised making one mark for each object to keep track without numbers.
Parth connected each run with one tick and each ball with one mark.
They produced six marks for six balls and four marks for four objects.
Parth suggested adding a seventh mark for a seventh ball.
Teach-back was not completed; one initial instruction needed clarification.
end.parentNote: Asha practised one-to-one marking with Parth using runs, balls, and objects. They explained the method and made the correct number of marks in the examples. There was a brief mix-up about whether to erase or add a mark, and it was corrected when Parth clarified, “एक निशान बनाओ”; they then continued correctly. At home, try matching small groups of objects with one dot or tick for each item, such as spoons or blocks.
